LESSON: SCRIPTURAL TEXTS SHANTI MANTRA SUTRA CHAPTER 11, 12 SUITTANIPATA SAHIB1- 8ASHTPA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Scriptural texts Shanti Mantra Sutra Chapter 11, 12 Suittanipata Sahib1- 8Ashtpa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Scriptural texts Shanti Mantra Sutra Chapter 11, 12 Suittanipata Sahib1- 8Ashtpa. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why are Scriptures important in our lives?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. apply values from the four selected Scriptures in daily life for sustainable living
2. create content to share relevant Scriptural messages that foster peace and harmony

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. apply values from the four selected Scriptures in daily life for sustainable living
   In simple words: practise until you can apply values from the four selected Scriptures in daily life for sustainable living. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. create content to share relevant Scriptural messages that foster peace and harmony
   In simple words: practise until you can create content to share relevant Scriptural messages that foster peace and harmony. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Scriptural texts Shanti Mantra Sutra Chapter 11, 12 Suittanipata Sahib1- 8Ashtpa using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Scriptural texts Shanti Mantra Sutra Chapter 11, 12 Suittanipata Sahib1- 8Ashtpa in the examples.
2. Explain Scriptural texts Shanti Mantra Sutra Chapter 11, 12 Suittanipata Sahib1- 8Ashtpa to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Scriptural texts Shanti Mantra Sutra Chapter 11, 12 Suittanipata Sahib1- 8Ashtpa.
4. Show that you can: apply values from the four selected Scriptures in daily life for sustainable living

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Scriptural texts Shanti Mantra Sutra Chapter 11, 12 Suittanipata Sahib1- 8Ashtpa using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Scriptural texts Shanti Mantra Sutra Chapter 11, 12 Suittanipata Sahib1- 8Ashtpa important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss with peers their findings from the research regarding the values drawn from different Scriptures,
2. Conduct research using digital media/digital media with assistive technology libraries/ magazines to identify Scriptures that promote peace in society through Scriptural texts,
3. Read and discuss with the parents/guardians how Scriptures promote peace and harmony,
4. Learning to Learn: learner will develop the skill of self-reflection when creating and presenting skits that address various approaches to how humankind can be more peaceful and harmonious.
5. Digital Literacy Skills: learner will develop Digital Citizenship Skills when conducting research using digital media/digital media with assistive technology. 6 Values:

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are Scriptures important in our lives?
2. How do the Scriptures promote peace and harmony in society?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. apply values from the four selected Scriptures in daily life for sustainable living
2. create content to share relevant Scriptural messages that foster peace and harmony

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
